scientific_integrity: Exact single-observation conditional probability and fixed-time, high-barrier asymptotic information theorem proved analytically; finite computations are supplementary. No independent mathematical audit or historical uniqueness certification.
scientific_limitations: Only pinned standard Brownian bridge, one predetermined noiseless real observation and constant positive upper barrier; pointwise fixed-time asymptotics. Finite-barrier global placement, threshold-dependent observation times, multitime/noisy sensing and other bridges are not proved.
title: Sharp rare-barrier information from one Brownian-bridge observation
